# dharma-javanese-texts fixtures

2026-09-01 from raw.githubusercontent.com:

- `editions/DHARMA_CritEdKakavinDesavarnana.xml` — TRIMMED to the
  edition's chapter 1 (the full file is 394 KB / 28 chapters; the

- `editions/DHARMA_CritEdBhimaSvarga.xml` — TRIMMED to the edition's

- `editions/DHARMA_DiplEdDurgastakaPerpusnasL128.xml` — WHOLE:
  a diplomatic manuscript transcription at folio-line grain (`1r1`).
- `editions/DHARMA_CritEdKidungSurajayaMSD.xml` — added 2026-11-13 from

Trims cut at element boundaries only; every retained byte is upstream's.
